verdict.rationale: Honeybadger documents a REST API through static reference pages covering notices, faults, projects, deploys and source maps. Nothing in the pack shows an interactive explorer or runnable 'try it' examples, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404, so there is no machine-readable spec to drive one. Static endpoint descriptions are only adjacent to this story and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
